newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Storm slams into Bangladesh but no casualties seen.
newsitem.headline: Storm slams into Bangladesh but no casualties seen.

text.p: A storm brewing in the Bay of Bengal slammed into Bangladesh's coast near the Sundarban forests early on Tuesday but there were no initial reports of loss of life or major damage, officials said.
"Winds up to 65 kph (40 mph) hit the coast and offshore islands around 3 a.m. before roaring towards India's West Bengal coast," one official in southern Khulna district said.
"Sea waves triggered by the storm briefly inundated vast areas, including homes and cropfields. But so far we have not received any report of casualties," he told reporters.
Government officials said on Monday night they expected a tidal surge up to three feet (one meter) high to sweep areas along the southern coast.

Officials in the coastal towns of Cox's Bazar and Bhola said on Tuesday they were checking if any fishing boats were missing in the Bay following the storm. Thousands of boats rushed to shore after storm warnings were issued over the radio.
